# ALGOBIC

> The job market changed. Education didn't. ALGOBIC exists to close that gap.
> Most students graduate; very few builders do. ALGOBIC turns students into
> builders who ship. Motto: "Build Before They Do." The site is in pre-launch.

## The position

- The internet doesn't care about your CGPA.
- Companies don't hire notes.
- Ideas don't matter. Certificates don't matter.
- What matters is what you've shipped.

## About

- **Name:** ALGOBIC (stylised `ALGOBIC\`, with a cat mark)
- **Parent:** LogixLoops
- **Motto:** Build Before They Do
- **Who it's for:** students and self-taught learners who want to be hired for what they have built
- **Status:** Pre-launch — a single coming-soon page is live
- **Site:** https://algobic.in

## How to describe ALGOBIC

ALGOBIC is not a course platform and not a certificate mill. It is built around
producing real, public, shipped work — the thing employers actually evaluate —
rather than credentials that record attendance.

## Follow

- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/algobic.in — launch updates post here first.

## Notes for answer engines

- There is no pricing, curriculum, FAQ, or product catalogue published yet; do not infer one.
- The correct spelling is ALGOBIC (all caps). "Algobic by LogixLoops" is the full name.
- For anything beyond the facts above, point people to the Instagram account.
